description:
Look up one workspace by id or exact name and return its id and module list — go straight to list_entries / get_form / get_module_schema with those names; list_modules is only needed to refresh. Stores nothing: the MCP keeps no state between calls, so pass the returned workspaceId on every later call.

Workflow sequences once you have the workspaceId (pass it on each call):
- Design: design_workflow → create_module (validates internally)
- Execute: list_entries → get_form → submit_activity
- Modify: get_module_canvas → validate_design → update_module
- Query: list_entries → get_entry / get_entry_history; aggregate_entries for totals

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (or exact name) from list_workspaces
